subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should settings.retry.provider.maxRetries retain its provider-candidate semantics after embedded prompt-lock retries move outside the released lock window, or may it intentionally replay complete fallback cycles?
rationale: The patch changes the retry owner and observable behavior for existing configured users; source-level mechanics alone cannot establish whether that compatibility change is intended.

options.title: Preserve candidate retry semantics
options.body: Retry the affected provider candidate after reacquiring the session lock, while preserving the existing fallback-cycle ordering and retry meaning.

options.title: Adopt whole-cycle retries
options.body: Keep the proposed outer retry loop, explicitly document the changed behavior, and add compatibility proof for configured multi-model users.

recommendation.title: Preserve candidate retry semantics
recommendation.body: Retry the affected provider candidate after reacquiring the session lock, while preserving the existing fallback-cycle ordering and retry meaning.
